normal.name: Anthony, of course
normal.text: So many #RetroGaming YouTube channels are just low-effort recomp/decomp/port videos now. I get that they need to survive, but I don't need a video every time someone asks Claude to decomp a game. That's not interesting. It's not what I watch retro gaming channels for. Such a shame

normal.name: Richard Orilla
normal.text: #EA just recently released 30th anniversary edition of #roadrash. Being able to play this game at 60fps on this game certainly brings joy in me, bonus points on built-in controller support on #linux (I have the #gog version played via #heroic) and the original quality videos. #retro #retrogaming

normal.text: While it is cool that EA puts a bunch of retro games on Steam and gives out some free upgrades, please remember: They killed Bioware. They are suffering bad PR. This is an easy good PR move from them. The Saudis want their money back. #gaming #retrogaming #ea #electronicarts #bioware
